About me

Hi, I'm Elizabeth.

I'm a UX designer based in New York City, currently on the Upper East Side after stints in Hell's Kitchen and Midtown East. Currently at Travelers, I've spent the last six years in UX following two internships that first got me hooked on user design. My work spans research, design, and strategy, and I run a fair number of workshops to get teams pointed in the same direction. Right now I'm supporting four developments across two areas.

Outside of work, I'm usually behind a camera, at my easel with a set of watercolors, or playing violin. I also love skiing, golf, and volunteering at my church.

Process

Research & Design

Prototype & Test: Real screens from my Figma files

Prototype & Test: Real screens from my Figma files
I also prototype in Code

I usually start in Figma, designing against a company's existing design system or library. From there, I connect Claude Code to that Figma file or library through GitHub, and use it to build quick, working prototypes I can click through, test with real users, or bring into an interview. Sometimes we'll even test a change in production through A/B testing.

I think AI-assisted prototyping like this is where the field is headed.
